card.name: Policy and informing-patient statements
card.fires_on: Words inside formal policy or consent statements, such as 'shall' after 'no person' in a non-discrimination policy. Also words in 'inform patients of the risk' or 'participation is voluntary' phrasing.

modes.label: Non-discrimination policy
modes.description: Words in a policy sentence saying no person shall be excluded from participation.
modes.example: It is the policy of the State Education Resource Center (SERC) that no person<< shall>> be discriminated against or excluded from participation

modes.description: Linking words in sentences telling clinicians to inform patients about risks or signs.

modes.description: Words stating that taking part in a clinical trial is voluntary.
